pack.topic: 3-Tier Property Verification Framework for Coimbatore Investors
pack.source_script_insight: The source demonstrates that structured multi-tier verification (survey list -> token cross-check -> physical inspection) eliminates error and ensures accurate asset delivery. In Coimbatore real estate, buyers must apply the exact same 3-step audit process—matching Patta records, FMB map sketches, and physical boundary stones—before committing funds.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Property buyers in Coimbatore often face title discrepancies between digital revenue records and actual physical boundaries. Applying a rigorous 3-tier verification check ensures clean plot titles across fast-growing industrial and residential sectors in Coimbatore.
pack.visual_strategy: Macro close-ups of parent deeds and Patta records, screen captures of digital revenue entry checks, handheld close-ups of FMB boundary maps, and physical measuring tape against concrete boundary stones on actual Coimbatore land parcels. Camera uses realistic eye-level macro focus and practical lighting.
pack.core_takeaway: Never rely on a single document or verbal assurance. Verify revenue records, FMB maps, and ground survey markers in a strict 3-tier check before buying property in Coimbatore.

pack.title_english: The 3-Step Verification Rule for Coimbatore Land
pack.caption_english: Before signing any land deed in Coimbatore, single-point document checks are not enough. Follow a strict 3-tier verification framework: first, cross-check digital Patta and Encumbrance Certificates against legal records; second, audit the Field Measurement Book (FMB) sketch; third, physically inspect ground survey stones with a field surveyor. Matching all three steps protects your investment capital from boundary overlaps and title errors. Partner with OliveTree Investors for structured, fully verified property opportunities in Coimbatore.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Production Prompt for AI Video Generator (OliveTree Investors - Coimbatore Only)

A. MANDATORY OUTPUT FORMAT LOCK
- Exact duration: 10.0 seconds total.
- Aspect Ratio: Native 9:16 vertical video format (portrait composition only).
- Target Audience: Property buyers in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

B. REALISM LOCK
- Photorealistic real-world documentary footage captured on a professional mirrorless camera.
- Settings: Authentic Tamil Nadu / Coimbatore daylight environments—red soil, coconut trees, local official paper forms, real measuring tapes, e-Services screen UI.
- Natural bright sunlight, realistic dynamic range, natural skin tones, sharp paper details, soft depth of field.
- ABSOLUTELY NO 3D renders, CGI, animated explainers, stock vector artwork, plastic surfaces, or architectural floorplan fly-throughs.

C. SOURCE SUBJECT LOCK
- Subject: Legal Risk & Multi-Tier Document Verification Protocol.
- Key Mechanisms: 1) Master Document Search, 2) Digital Patta/Revenue Registry Cross-check, 3) FMB Map Match, 4) Ground Boundary Survey Tape Verification.
- Application: Property investment verification in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.

D. SUBJECT-SPECIFIC VISUAL STRATEGY
- Focus tightly on physical verification items: official document ledgers, laptop showing government land records, FMB field sketches, land surveyor tools, and concrete plot boundary stones.
- Camera Grammar: Macro document close-ups, handheld over-the-shoulder inspection shots, crisp low-angle site measurements.
- Strictly avoid generic plot-to-house construction sequences or happy-family keys handovers.

E. CAMERA AND IMAGE QUALITY
- Cinematic 4K video feel, stable micro-movements, crisp optical focus, authentic filmic color grading, realistic Coimbatore sunlight shadows.

F. EXACT 7-SHOT SEQUENCE PLAN

Shot 1 (0.0s - 1.4s)
- Location: Well-lit Coimbatore property lawyer desk.
- Visual: Top-down macro shot of hands laying out an official Tamil Nadu land title deed alongside an Encumbrance Certificate (EC).
- Camera: Static overhead macro, natural desk light.
- Text Overlay: '1. Master Check'
- Tamil VO: 'ஒரு சொத்து வாங்கும் முன்...'

Shot 2 (1.4s - 2.8s)
- Location: Office interior.
- Visual: Close-up of a finger pointing at survey numbers on the Tamil Nadu revenue e-services portal display on a laptop, comparing with a printed physical document.
- Camera: Shallow depth of field macro shot focusing on screen numbers and finger movement.
- Text Overlay: '2. Record Audit'
- Tamil VO: '...3-அடுக்கு சரிபார்ப்பு அவசியம்.'

Shot 3 (2.8s - 4.2s)
- Location: Sunny outdoor plot boundary in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Over-the-shoulder handheld shot of an auditor unfolding an official Field Measurement Book (FMB) diagram paper.
- Camera: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up, natural daylight.
- Text Overlay: '3. Map Match'
- Tamil VO: 'பட்டா சரிபார்ப்பு,'

Shot 4 (4.2s - 5.6s)
- Location: Coimbatore land parcel with red soil and coconut palms in soft background focus.
- Visual: Low-angle shot of a field surveyor placing a yellow measuring tape against a marked concrete survey boundary stone.
- Camera: Low-angle ground level, sharp focus on stone and tape text.
- Text Overlay: '4. Ground Check'
- Tamil VO: 'FMB வரைபடம்,'

Shot 5 (5.6s - 7.0s)
- Location: Coimbatore plot site.
- Visual: Handheld shot showing a inspector comparing the physical measuring tape length against a checklist on a wooden clipboard.
- Camera: Slight pan down from tape to clipboard, realistic motion.
- Text Overlay: '5. Boundary Audit'
- Tamil VO: 'மற்றும் கள ஆய்வு—'

Shot 6 (7.0s - 8.5s)
- Location: Office desk / clipboard.
- Visual: Macro shot of a black pen checking off a box on a verified audit sheet titled 'Coimbatore Land Verification Passed'.
- Camera: Macro tight shot focusing on pen movement.
- Text Overlay: '6. Verified Title'
- Tamil VO: 'மூன்றையும் ஒப்பிட்டு உறுதி செய்யுங்கள்!'

Shot 7 (8.5s - 10.0s)
- Location: Sunny verified property site in Coimbatore.
- Visual: Confident property buyer accepting a verified green document folder with Coimbatore green landscape in background.
- Camera: Eye-level steady camera, slight push-in.
- Text Overlay: 'OliveTree Investors'
- Tamil VO: 'OliveTree Investors.'

G. MOTION GRAPHICS LIMIT
- Only clean, minimal 1-2 word text overlays centered or lower third. No flashy 2D graphic transition, no motion graphics takeovers.

H. FINAL REAL SCENE
- Finish on real location (Shot 7) with real sunlight and natural scenery. Overlay minimal brand mark 'OliveTree Investors'. No black screens or standalone graphic end-cards.

I. NEGATIVE PROMPT & BANNED ELEMENTS
- Ban: 2D/3D cartoon graphics, animated charts, house construction sequences, moving architectural models, non-Coimbatore landscapes, fake city skylines, duplicated human faces, camera crew reflections, heavy fantasy color filters, fisheye lenses, fast whip-pans.
